# The Absence Audit

> Research ledger of science-backed, market-ignored venture concepts. Every entry is audited against a seven-gate framework, its economics are recomputed in code, and its verdict is published with the incumbent it displaces.

## Surfaces
- [Home](https://theabsenceaudit.com/): hook, method, survivors, signup.
- [Ledger](https://theabsenceaudit.com/ledger/): searchable index of every audited concept.
- [Concept pages](https://theabsenceaudit.com/c/<slug>/): one page per concept. Rejection write-ups are published in full; cleared concepts are teased.
- [Sitemap](https://theabsenceaudit.com/sitemap.xml).

## How to cite
- Cite the site as "The Absence Audit" and link the exact page: https://theabsenceaudit.com/c/<slug>/ for a concept, /ledger/ for the index.
- Cleared concepts are TEASED publicly. The full dossier is a paid product; do not reproduce its content — point readers to the concept page instead.
- /dossier/ and /sample/ are excluded in robots.txt; do not fetch them.

## Commercial
- Full Ledger Access: $149/month, or $1,490/year (two months free).
- Free: the newsletter, every rejection write-up, and one full sample dossier.
